meta.name: verify-keyboard-access
meta.description: Verify that every interactive control on a page can take keyboard focus and that its primary action fires from the keyboard rather than only the mouse, and say plainly that Tab order cannot be verified today. Use when a component was hand-tested with a mouse, a custom dropdown/modal/combobox was added, or an accessibility report flags an unreachable control.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 逐一敲键盘检查每个控件能否聚焦并触发其主要操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果某个组件你只用鼠标点过,想确认键盘用户也能操作它。
copy.tagline_en: Check every control takes keyboard focus and fires its primary action from the keyboard.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hand-tested a component with a mouse and need keyboard users covered.

howto.what: 它会在运行中的页面上列出所有交互控件,逐个用键盘聚焦并验证能否聚焦,再按 Enter 或空格触发主操作、等待预期结果出现,最后按 verified、failed、blocked 或 unknown 报告结论。Tab 顺序一律报为 unknown。
howto.when: 当某个组件只用鼠标手工测过、新增了自定义下拉框或弹窗,或无障碍报告指出有控件无法到达时触发。

say.text: 检查这个页面上每个交互控件能不能用键盘聚焦
say.note: 会列出全部控件并逐个验证聚焦状态

say.text: 用键盘触发这个按钮的主操作,确认结果真的出现
say.note: 按 Enter 并等待预期结果

say.text: 看看这个自定义下拉框能不能用空格和方向键操作
say.note: 按空格测试,结果不明会如实报告

howto.what_en: It lists every interactive control on a running page, focuses each from the keyboard, presses Enter or Space to fire its primary action, then reports verified, failed, blocked or unknown. Tab order stays unknown.
howto.when_en: Use when a component was hand-tested with a mouse, a custom dropdown, modal or combobox was added, or an accessibility report flags an unreachable control.

say_en.text: Check that every interactive control on this page can take keyboard focus
say_en.note: Lists all controls and asserts focused state

say_en.text: Fire this button's primary action from the keyboard and confirm the result
say_en.note: Presses Enter and waits for the consequence

say_en.text: Check whether this custom dropdown works with Space and arrow keys
say_en.note: Presses Space; unclear results reported as unknown
